text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can produce art, music, and writing that look or sound surprisingly human. Some people worry that this will replace artists and writers, but others see AI as a helpful partner. For example, a musician might use AI to get new ideas, or a writer might use it to improve a story. However, human creativity is still special. Machines can copy styles and create patterns, but they do not have real feelings or personal experiences. True creativity comes from human emotions, imagination, and the desire to express something meaningful. AI can support us, but it cannot replace the human heart behind art.
